doc: Blind rerun (I96): the FACT sidecar of M3 (holon.rules.fact.Sidecar; holon.fact). Its document is the Rollup transitions document of the typed-sorts sidecar spec/M3/lib/sort_types.json; its binding the binding spec spec/M3/lib/binding.json; its term-size budget FACT's, spec/M3/lib/term_size.json. No hypothesis: the premise hypotheses and their results are oracle records, not code. The search and measure sections are empty, so holon.fact.search and holon.measures_fact keep the tooling's defaults. No back-test map: the M1 FACT laws are another milestone's.
